metaTitle: Land Rover Turbo & Ancillary Repair | Land Rover Garage
metaDescription: Professional Land Rover turbocharger repair and replacement services. We work on all turbocharged diesel and petrol engines, from Td5 to modern Ingenium and BMW-sourced V8s.
lede: Turbocharger replacement, repair, and calibration for all Land Rover diesel and petrol engines.

blocks.html: Turbocharger repairs on Land Rovers vary by engine and configuration. We handle single-turbo, twin-turbo, and hot-vee setups. The process follows manufacturer procedures, including full JLR diagnostic calibration after any replacement.

Typical scope includes access, removal, inspection, replacement or rebuild, reassembly with new gaskets and lines, and full road testing. We also check ancillary components such as wastegates, actuators, and boost sensors.
For a deeper look at our workshop standards, see [About Us](/about).

steps.title: Access & Preparation
steps.body: Vehicle on lift, bonnet removed where needed, under-trays and heat shields removed, oil and coolant drained.

steps.title: Removal
steps.body: Turbocharger located, exhaust and oil/coolant lines disconnected, mounting bolts unbolted, turbo lifted out.

steps.title: Inspection
steps.body: Turbo condition assessed, mounting faces checked, oil feed lines inspected for coking, wastegate and sensors tested.

steps.title: Reassembly
steps.body: New or rebuilt turbo fitted, new gaskets and bolts used, oil and coolant lines reconnected, boost pipes and exhaust remade.

steps.title: Calibration & Testing
steps.body: New oil and filter, coolant refilled. JLR diagnostic calibration (turbo and air path) carried out. Road test performed.

items.q: How much does a Land Rover turbocharger replacement cost?
items.a: Prices start from £1,200 and vary by engine and configuration. Twin-turbo and hot-vee setups are at the higher end. We provide a fixed-price quote after inspection. See our [pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer).

items.q: Do I need a new turbocharger or can mine be repaired?
items.a: It depends on the condition. Some turbos can be rebuilt with a new cartridge; others need full replacement. We'll inspect and advise accordingly.

items.q: What ancillary components do you check?
items.a: We check wastegates, actuators, boost sensors, and related hoses. We'll replace anything that falls outside manufacturer specification.

items.q: How long does a turbocharger repair take?
items.a: Typically 2–3 working days, depending on parts availability and engine configuration. We'll confirm timings when we book your Land Rover in.

items.q: Do you offer recovery if my Land Rover can't be driven?
items.a: Yes. We offer nationwide recovery from £70, with most vehicles recovered within a few hours of booking. Contact us for a recovery quote.
